scope: Actual upward gasket faces by component owner; no pressure/containment claim

rear-main-cap.name: Main cap 7
rear-main-cap.function: Closes the crankshaft main bearing bore beneath the block. Each installed cap must retain its original position and orientation.

rear-crank-seal.name: Rear crankshaft seal
rear-crank-seal.function: Limits oil leakage at the rear crankshaft exit. Seal lip and housing fit need exact dimensions.
